extensionDescription.message: Provider add-on for TbSync that synchronizes Google Contacts with Thunderbird.

setup.intro.message: To connect to a Google account, provide an OAuth client ID and secret you created in the Google Cloud console. Specify an account label to identify the new account in TbSync.

setup.credentialsHelpLink.message: How to create your Google Cloud Console credentials

setup.redirectHint.message: The Client ID must belong to an OAuth Web application client, and its Authorized redirect URIs must include this add-on's redirect URL.

setup.error.credentialsRequired.message: Please enter both the Client ID and the Client secret.

setup.error.missingToken.message: Missing setup token. Open this window through TbSync.

config.readOnlyMode.message: Read-only (do not push local changes to Google)

config.readOnlyBanner.message: To prevent synchronization errors, settings cannot be edited while the account is enabled.
